item.description: Red witchweed was first discovered in Habana in 2013 and remains the only known infestation in the country.

item.title: ABC News: Two men charged over alleged nail gun road rage incident on M1
item.description: Police allege a nail fired from a ute struck an SUV driver in the face before the vehicles collided near Appin Road on the M1 Princes Motorway.

item.title: ABC News: Sixers win WBBL clash despite Ellyse Perry's strange run-out
item.description: Ellyse Perry is caught out by an odd process during the Sydney Sixers' WBBL innings, given out after a replay on the big screen prompted umpires to reconsider their original decision.

item.title: ABC News: SA gives green light for gas to help power future data centres
item.description: The South Australian government says it is "absolutely fine" for gas to be used to help power data centres, despite its strategy focusing on renewable energy as the source.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Home affairs minister considers backdown on backpacker visa policy
item.description: Tony Burke is considering changing the government's backpacker visa policy, which was announced two months ago at the National Press Club. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: AFLW has come a long way but this player 'doesn’t want to settle'
item.description: This weekend Jenna Richardson's Hawthorn will face Carlton in a semi-final rematch of last year.

item.title: ABC News: Only four government ministers have saved money this year. Here's who
item.description: As the government pursues savings "across the board" ahead of the mid-year budget update, an ABC analysis shows only a handful of ministers have managed net savings so far this year.

item.title: ABC News: Midwife will have to turn away clients under homebirth changes
item.description: Jenny Spencer says she will have to halve her caseload under a new federal insurance scheme that only covers some private midwives for homebirth.

item.title: ABC News: How the decline of the department store could shape the future of shopping
item.description: Department stores are fading away and retailers are grappling with the challenges of online trade. So what might this mean for physical shops and consumers?

item.title: ABC News: Advocates praise Qld government changes to service access
item.description: The state government has announced it will add seniors, carers and companion cards to the new Service Queensland app, sparking concerns about increased digitisation.

item.title: ABC News: Financial pain of outer suburbs fuelled demise of David Jones, experts say
item.description: After 188 years, David Jones announced it would close 19 stores, most of them in Sydney's outer suburbs.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Microsoft platforms suffering widespread outages, including Outlook
item.description: A widespread outage has hit Microsoft platforms including Outlook, with many users encountering trouble using their email accounts and other errors across the tech giant's suite of apps.

item.title: ABC News: Four Victorians named in Australian of the Year awards
item.description: A pancreatic cancer advocate whose late husband played for the Hawks has been recognised as the 2027 Australian of the Year for Victoria.

item.title: ABC News: Geelong mother says she is living in city of broken election promises
item.description: With a raft of promised projects either scrapped, delayed or ignored, Geelong could be a test case for whether voters turn against governments who do not fulfil their election pledges.

item.title: ABC News: Trump says US does not 'need' Iran deal
item.description: Donald Trump's comments come after reports his vice-president was considering face-to-face peace talks with a hard-line Iranian security official.
